product_title: Gadopiclenol Injection \ MultiHance® Gadobenate Dimeglumine Contrast Agent
product_summary: Gadopiclenol Injection, also known as VUEWAY™ (gadopiclenol) injection, is a new, highly stable, and macrocyclic gadolinium-based contrast agent (GBCA) approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for use in adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older. This injection is designed for use in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the central nervous system (brain, spine, and surrounding tissues) and the body (head and neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, and musculoskeletal system). The approved dose for Gadopiclenol Injection is 0.05 mmol/kg, which has been shown to improve the detection and visualization of lesions over unenhanced MRI alone and to provide similar diagnostic efficacy compared to 0.1 mmol/kg of the lower-relaxivity Gadobutrol injection. The product is highly stable and offers the highest relaxivity among gadolinium-based contrast agents available in the United States. The approval of Gadopiclenol Injection follows Priority Review, which is granted for products that are considered significant improvements in safety or effectiveness compared to standard options. The pivotal Phase III studies supporting the approval were designed as crossover studies, comparing MRI of the CNS or MRI of the body with 0.05 mmol/kg VUEWAY injection or unenhanced MRI alone, and 0.05 mmol/kg Gadopiclenol with 0.1 mmol/kg Gadobutrol in adult patients. The studies showed that MRI with Gadopiclenol was non-inferior to MRI with the full dose of Gadobutrol, with Gadopiclenol providing better quality visualization of lesions. No major safety signals were reported during the development of VUEWAY in either adult or pediatric patients, and the adverse events reported during the two Phase III studies were similar for both products administered. The product will be commercialized by Bracco under the brand name VUEWAY™ (gadopiclenol) injection and VUEWAY™ (gadopiclenol) Pharmacy Bulk Package. The strategic collaboration between Bracco and Guerbet in December 2021 resulted in the commercialization of the product independently under different brand names. The collaboration is expected to accelerate access to Gadopiclenol and deliver innovation, better care to patients and caregivers alike. \ MultiHance® Gadobenate Dimeglumine Contrast Agent is a gadolinium-based contrast agent (GBCA) specifically approved for use in diagnostic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the liver in both adult and pediatric patients aged two years and older. This product is available in the European Union, Norway, and Iceland. The active ingredient, gadobenate dimeglumine (Gd-BOPTA), is a gadolinium-based contrast agent with an aromatic benzyloxymethyl group, which enhances its ability to transport into functioning hepatocytes. Up to 4% of the injected dose is excreted via the hepatobiliary route into the bile and feces. MultiHance® is suitable for both dynamic and delayed liver-specific imaging, offering extended opportunities for the assessment of focal liver lesions. Dynamic imaging is unaffected by short-term dyspnea and respiratory motion artifacts, while delayed imaging provides increased sensitivity and specificity for detecting and characterizing liver disease. The product is administered at a dose of 0.05 mmol/kg body weight (0.1 mL/kg of the 0.5 M solution), ensuring sufficient enhancement for diagnostic purposes. The safety profile of MultiHance® has been well-established through numerous clinical investigations and extensive worldwide use, with over 35 million doses administered. It has been studied in children and special populations, including those with renal and liver function impairments. The product is designed to provide high relaxivity and liver specificity, with increased r1-relaxivity relative to macrocyclic GBCAs, resulting in greater signal intensity (SI) enhancement on T1-weighted images. MultiHance® is intended for use in clinical settings where diagnostic information is essential and not available with non-contrast enhanced MRI, and it is recommended to be used with caution in patients with severe renal impairment and during liver transplantation periods.

product_summary: The Travelpro MaxLite 5 - 21" Expandable Carry-on Spinner 4011761 is a lightweight and highly functional carry-on luggage option designed for ultimate comfort and mobility. This spinner suitcase is part of the Travelpro MaxLite series, known for its innovative design and practical features. The suitcase is 21 inches in length and weighs 5.4 lbs, making it one of the lightest wheeled carry-on suitcases available. It features a 2-position adjustable PowerScope Lite handle, which can be locked in two positions (38 inches and 42.5 inches) to accommodate users of different heights. The handle is equipped with patented Contour Grip, which includes rubberized touch points for a comfortable handhold and easier maneuvering. The suitcase is equipped with four 360° rotating spinners that glide effortlessly, providing effortless maneuverability and a smooth roll in any direction. The polyester fabric with DuraGuard® coating resists water and stains, ensuring the luggage remains looking great. The unique bottom tray design increases durability and stabilizes the wheels for trouble-free alignment and maneuverability. The suitcase expands up to 2 inches to maximize packing capacity with a tapered shape to prevent tipping. It includes two quick-access, exterior front pockets, a full-length interior lid pocket, a side accessory pocket, and adjustable hold-down straps. The ergonomic, high-tensile-strength expandable zipper pulls are tough yet easy on the hands. The low-profile top, side, and bottom carry handles offer additional packing convenience and flexibility. The suitcase also features a high-tensile-strength zipper pull and a unique bottom tray design that increases durability and stabilizes the wheels for trouble-free alignment and maneuverability. The H20 Guard protects the interior lining from moisture. The Travelpro MaxLite 5 - 21" Expandable Carry-on Spinner 4011761 is backed by Travelpro® Built For A Lifetime Limited Warranty, ensuring long-term reliability and customer satisfaction. The overall dimensions of the suitcase are H: 23in W: 14.5in D: 9in, and it fits most carry-on criteria. The case dimensions are H: 21in W: 14in D: 9in, with a volume of 46L. This item is available for purchase at a sale price of $144.49, down from the regular price of $340.00. Payment options include ShopPay and other secure methods. It features a unique lifestyle design in collaboration with the V&A, a leading museum of art, design, and performance, based on a magnificent furisode (swinging sleeves) kimono from the V&A collection. The design reflects the dynamism of Japanese textile design from the early 20th century, with auspicious motifs of bamboo and plum blossom suggesting it may have been worn for a special occasion. The bag is equipped with a zip top closure and an inner zip pocket for added security and organization. It is fitted with sturdy faux leather handles for easy carrying and a reinforced base with four studded feet for stability. The bag measures 15.4 x 10.6 x 7.9 inches and weighs 1.1 lb, providing ample space for travel or gym essentials. It is easy to clean with a damp cloth and should not be soaked in water. product_summary: Molecular Sieve 4A is a specialized product made from 4A zeolite powder combined with attapulgite clay, resulting in a sodium form of type A zeolite crystal structure. This product features an effective pore opening of approximately 4 angstroms (0.4 nm), making it highly effective in adsorbing molecules with a kinetic diameter of less than 4 angstroms. It is particularly adept at adsorbing simple gas molecules such as oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, and straight-chain hydrocarbons, while excluding branched-chain hydrocarbons and aromatics. The product is known for its high mass transfer efficiency, high mechanical strength, and durability. It is widely used for drying and removing CO2 from natural gas, LPG, and air. Additionally, it is effective in the removal of hydrocarbons, ammonia, and methanol from gas streams, and in the dehydration of refrigerants and air in air break units of buses, trucks, and locomotives. Molecular Sieve 4A can also be packed in small bags for use as a desiccant for foods, electronics elements, and drugs. The product is manufactured by Luoyang Jalon and is available in various sizes and forms, including beads and pellets. The beads are available in sizes of 8X12 mm (1.6-2.5 mm) and 4X8 mm (3.0-5.0 mm), while the pellets are available in sizes of 1/16 mm (1.5-1.7 mm) and 1/8 mm (3.0-3.2 mm). For optimal storage, it is recommended to keep the molecular sieve in an airtight container to prevent moisture adsorption. The product can be regenerated or activated using thermal regeneration methods such as Thermal Swing Adsorption (TSA) or pressure swing processes (PSA). A properly regenerated or activated molecular sieve can achieve moisture dew points below -100°C, depending on the gas present and the process conditions. The product is manufactured in Henan, China, and is available for long-term supply. The price is negotiable, and the delivery terms are flexible, with payment due upon delivery. \ Electrical deionization equipment designed for the removal of ions from water, suitable for various industrial and laboratory applications. \ Furnace Sorbent Injection (FSI) Technology is a specialized process that involves the direct injection of sorbents into furnaces or boilers, or the mixing of these sorbents with fuel. This technology is primarily utilized in Waste-to-Energy and biomass plants to address critical environmental and operational issues. The sorbents used in FSI are designed to control acid gas emissions, such as SO2 and HF, and reduce fouling and slagging in the furnace or boiler. The high reaction temperature and absence of competitive reactions with CO2 make acid gas capture highly efficient under FSI conditions. Additionally, the injection of sorbents increases the melting temperature of boiler ash, further enhancing the efficiency of acid gas removal. The benefits of FSI technology are significant, including improved SOx capture, debottlenecked flue gas treatment (FGT), savings on incumbent FGT reagent, and reduced residue disposal costs. The sorbents also contribute to anti-slagging and antifouling properties, such as higher heat transfer capacity, increased waste throughput, and reduced maintenance and cleaning costs. product_title: Energy Storage Cutter \ Electro-Mechanical Anchor
product_summary: The Energy Storage Cutter is a specialized tool designed for cutting slickline or wireline by utilizing the internal stored energy of the cutter. This tool is engineered to trigger the release of stored energy with minimal force, making it highly efficient and safe for downhole operations. The Energy Storage Cutter is available in two regular sizes and a table master size, with specific dimensions for each size: 1.5" OD, 1.375" Fish Neck OD, and 5ft length for the first size; 1.875" OD, 1.875" Fish Neck OD, and 5ft length for the second size; and 2.5" OD, 2.25" Fish Neck OD, and 5ft length for the third size. It is capable of cutting downhole slickline or wireline with an outer diameter ranging from 0-0.160 inches and wireline with an outer diameter of 0-15/32 inches. The cutter is particularly suitable for highly deviated wells and heavy oil wells, offering fast installation and simple operation. It features both mechanical and electronic trigger modes, with the mechanical mode requiring the BOP to be opened and the energy storage cutter to be run into the well. product_summary: Pulsonix Spice Simulation is a comprehensive and fully integrated solution designed to enhance the design and simulation of electronic circuits. The library is fully integrated, eliminating the need for additional or separate libraries when switching between simulation, schematic capture, and PCB design processes. The software includes stimuli and probes for nominated Spice simulators, which can be dropped into the Pulsonix design to drive the simulator using commands recognized by the host system. It also supports working with LTSpice, allowing direct simulation from the Pulsonix Schematic and providing a Spice library for LTSpice sources and various probes. The LTSpice library can be accessed using functional dialogs for properties and analysis selection. Additionally, the software offers Monte Carlo and bias markers for enhanced simulation, with sources for power, waveform generators, and other components to be added to the LTSpice netlist. Pulsonix Spice Simulation is available in a free trial version that includes all features of the full edition, with a limitation of 100 component pins. This software is ideal for users looking to streamline their design and simulation processes with a powerful and integrated solution.
